Retired MacBook Air from active fleet and consolidated all Apple Silicon MLX/Metal work onto Ryan's MacBook Pro (M5 Max). Updated fleet config, infographic, backlog, README, and standing 4h sprint schedule, and launched 3 parallel Cycle 2 frontier tracks (T1-04 Fable 5.2, T3-01 Opus 5.5, T2-02 GPT 6.2 Astra at high effort).
